title: 第27章 这就是家里备的普通茶叶
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
大概很少人能想得到，身为太虚宗一峰长老、合体期大能修士的惊鸿剑尊平日里竟是衣着褴褛的“野人”，要是他站在自己主人身边，玄羽都怕别人误会主人苛待老人。

    “小璃月找我？”

    自从招生大典那天被三个逆徒气走，他还没想过要回去。

    现在小璃找上门，要不去看看？

    “老祖，你看这情况，要不要跟我过去一趟……”

    刚刚发生过这种事情，李归鸿怕老祖不愿过去，毕竟不久前他还在一个劲地埋怨自己。

    强行请人？

    不不不，他怕被打。

    “去，当然要去，老夫倒是要看看，你到底收了怎样一个弟子……”

    谢家。

    “咚咚咚。”

    威压消散，谢长泽带着自家父亲和师弟师妹们来到微生璃月房间门口，敲响房门。

    “小师妹，你休息了吗？”

    他们抵达南域的时辰尚早，此时天还未暗，就是刚刚小师妹院子里弄出来的异象仍有残留，原本的晴朗白日此时一片橘红。

    “没有休息，大师兄你们直接进来吧！”微生璃月淡然道。

    她知道大师兄他们来找自己是因为什么，异象发生在谢府，刚才南落城附近又来了这么多大乘期修士，但凡修为高一点的，都能感应到气氛不寻常。

    大师兄二师姐他们一个元婴巅峰，一个金丹巅峰，多少知道点情况。

    就算感应不到周围的大乘修士，他们也能通过方才的异象知道情况不一般。

    找上门来询问，理所应当。

    谢闻笙有幸跟着儿子进入微生小姐的院子，只见那人正坐在屋内主座，悠然的饮着茶水。

    虽不知道是什么茶，可谢闻笙却从那缕清香中感悟到一丝不寻常道韵，此茶必定不凡。

    “师兄师姐这次过来，是为了刚才产生的异象？”

    待众人落座，微生璃月开门见山道。
content_en:
Probably few people would have imagined that Jinghong Sword Master, an elder of the Taixu Sect and a powerful monk in the Fusion Stage, was actually a ragged "savage" on weekdays. If he stood next to his master, Xuan Yu was afraid that others would misunderstand that his master treated the old man harshly.

"Xiao Liyue is looking for me?"

Ever since he was angered away by three rebels on the day of the admissions ceremony, he has not thought about going back.

Now that Xiaoli is here, why don't you go take a look?

"Ancestor, look at this situation, do you want to come with me..."

This kind of thing happened just now, and Li Guihong was afraid that his ancestor would not want to go there. After all, he was still blaming himself not long ago.

Recruit someone by force?

No, no, no, he was afraid of being beaten.

"Go, of course I want to go, I want to see what kind of disciple you have accepted..."

Xie family.

"Dong dong dong."

After the pressure dissipated, Xie Changze took his father and junior brothers and sisters to the door of Weisheng Liyue's room and knocked on the door.

"Junior sister, have you rested?"

It was still early when they arrived in the Southern Territory, and it was still dark. Even the strange phenomenon that had just happened in the junior sister's yard still remained, and the originally sunny day was now orange-red.

"There is no rest, senior brother, you can come directly in!" Weisheng Liyue said calmly.

She knew why Senior Brother and the others came to her. The vision happened in Xie Mansion. So many Mahayana monks came near Nanluo City just now. Anyone with a higher level of cultivation can sense that the atmosphere is unusual.

The eldest brother, the second senior sister, they are both at the peak of Nascent Soul and the other at the peak of Golden Core, so they know a little bit about the situation.

Even if they couldn't sense the Mahayana monks around them, they could still tell that the situation was unusual through the vision just now.

It's natural to come to the door and ask.

Xie Wensheng was lucky enough to follow his son into Miss Weisheng's yard, and saw that man sitting in the main seat of the house, drinking tea leisurely.

Although he didn't know what kind of tea it was, Xie Wensheng felt an unusual Taoist charm from the fragrance. This tea must be extraordinary.

"Senior brother and sister, are you here this time because of the strange phenomenon that happened just now?"

When everyone was seated, Weisheng Liyue came straight to the point.
title_en: Chapter 27 This is the ordinary tea prepared at home
